title: fd6: receiveTypingIndicators in jmap-chat-wss-guide.md
description:
Add suppression check note to jmap-chat-wss-guide.md fan-out architecture section.

What: Tell implementors that the fan-out delivery path must check receiveTypingIndicators before sending ChatTypingEvent frames.

Algorithm:
1. Locate the fan-out architecture section in jmap-chat-wss-guide.md. Find the paragraph describing the delivery path (application logic -> pub/sub -> handler -> membership check -> send).
2. Append to that paragraph (or add a new sentence after the membership-check sentence):
   'In addition to the membership check, each handler MUST check Chat.receiveTypingIndicators for the target owner before sending a ChatTypingEvent frame. If the field is false, the handler MUST silently drop the event. This check belongs in the delivery path alongside the membership check, not at subscribe time.'

Defensive rules: The guide is non-normative prose but implementors read it. Use MUST to match the normative spec. One addition only, no removals.
acceptance_criteria: jmap-chat-wss-guide.md fan-out architecture section updated with receiveTypingIndicators check note.
